description: Writes the fiche fields you pass, and leaves the others as they are. What is written here is recorded as coming from a person, which keeps a later reading by Iris from overwriting it.

contact_id.description: The id of the contact, as list_contacts gives it.

contact_title.description: Their role there, for example "Directrice generale".

language.description: The language to write to them in, as a code such as "fr", "en" or "mg".

phone.description: Their phone number, as they gave it.

name: update_contact
title: Enrich a contact fiche
